result.brief: CrossEdit 提出统一的全模态（图像/音频/视频）编辑模型，通过跨模态迁移与自监督音视频掩码重建实现零样本音视频电影场景编辑，并发布 CrossEditBench 基准与 AV-FES 指标。
result.reason: Unified omni-modal editing model for images, audio, video with cross-modal transfer and self-supervised AV masked reconstruction; joint AV editing and lip-synced speech editing.
